title: TITLE: ROOM AROUND THE LINE
why: The critic wants air: the one line sat 12px under the fullscreen row. 24px above and 16px below.
now: The title line has more room around it.

edits.anchor: #root #title #titletag{ margin-top:var(--sp-3); font:700 var(--fs-title)/1.1 var(--f-cond); letter-spacing:var(--track); color:var(--tx-1); }
edits.replacement: #root #title #titletag{ margin:24px 0 16px; font:700 var(--fs-title)/1.1 var(--f-cond); letter-spacing:var(--track); color:var(--tx-1); }   /* v28.xx (cw-title-gap): the one line had 12px above it and sat on the fullscreen row; 24px above, 16px below the key row. */
